questions.q: Which ingredient gives beer its bitterness and acts as a natural preservative?
questions.exp: The guide describes hops as the flowering cone of the hop plant, bringing aroma, flavour and bitterness to balance malt sweetness, with antibacterial properties that preserve the beer.

questions.q: Which yeast species does the guide name for lagers?
questions.exp: Lagers ferment cool and slow with Saccharomyces pastorianus, while ales ferment warm and fast with Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the top fermenting yeast.

questions.q: On a beer label, what does the abbreviation IBU stand for?
questions.exp: The guide defines IBU as the International Bitterness Unit: the higher the IBUs, the more bitter the beer, so the figure helps a guest judge a style before tasting.
